# Water Explosion(K Explosion) Early
[简体中文](https://github.com/chenjunfu2/kexplosion-early/blob/master/README.md)  
Port of the "Water Explosion(K Explosion)" feature from MCJE 1.21.2–1.21.5:  
Prevents explosions that occur in water from damaging the following non-living entities
- Item entities
- Item Frame entities
- Glow Item Frame entities
- Armor Stand entities
- Leash Knot entities
- Painting entities

**Note:** The "Water Explosion" feature is colloquially known as "K Explosion" in the community, named after its discoverer, user `K____D`.  

# Caution
This mod conflicts with the `carpet mod` rule `optimizedTNT`.  
If the mod does not work as expected, please disable the `optimizedTNT` rule in `carpet mod`.
